subject: literacy
concept: Writing an analytical response evaluating an informational text's claim, evidence, and organization, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their response using a claim/evidence-quality/structure organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes an analytical paragraph evaluating a text's central claim, the strength of its evidence, and its organizational effectiveness

assessment.mastery_threshold: response addresses all three elements (claim, evidence quality, organization) with specific textual reference
misconception_flags: summarizes the text's content rather than evaluating its claim, evidence, or structure

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
